How Bad Air Has Redrawn Playing Field For Schools 🏤 

Schools are left with an increasingly narrow window for outdoor sport whole year.

May-June: Extreme Heat ☀️

July-Aug: Rains 🌧

Sept: Exams ✏️

Oct: Prime Outdoor Window 🤼

Nov-Dec: Pollution Restrictions 🌬

We collectively including government need to take steps urgently otherwise kid's future will be dark.
